notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.2 — 🎮 Every minigame panel is an embed now. Push Your Luck, Simon, Don't Pop It, Rock Paper Scissors, Slots and Blackjack all drew their boards with plain content and never looked at rich output — all 21 panels go through one helper that honours it. 💬 The Chat tab draws embeds as cards, the way Discord does: coloured spine, title, body, inline fields, footer, with markdown rendered inside them. They used to be squashed into a single "▧ title · body" line, which lost the shape entirely, and user IDs leaked through as raw <@…> instead of names. 🔇 "Activation is currently off" is now told ONCE per person per off period rather than answering every command — nothing changes between one command and the next while we're off — and there's a switch in Game → Messages to silence it completely, which is what you want on a second install that only sits quiet.
